**What changes and why**

**Checks**
- [ ] `node --test` passes on a supported Node (22, 24 or 26)
- [ ] An added or changed action is in `docs/api.md` and `docs/proof-matrix.md` was regenerated
- [ ] No dependency was added
- [ ] No token, tunnel address, pane id, machine path or real screen text in the diff, the description or a receipt
- [ ] If this widens what a caller can do: the reason is stated above and a test shows the refusal paths
